name: Anri
source:
A ghost girl who suddenly visits Reiji's room. She can pass through walls and float in the air but she has legs and reacts like a living person.

Without a care as to why she is a ghost she is immensely fascinated with erotic things. Drawn in by Reiji's backed up sexual desire she is found watching him masturbating, until then she had never been seen by anyone.

[From [url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/wendybell/tukikano/char.html]official site[/url]]
